column1: # Checks in the cra, dora and nis2 packs that are DECLARED UNPRICED.
# A check with an all-zero frequency triple contributes exactly nothing to
# reported exposure however often it fails. That is a legitimate state -- a
# magnitude without a calibrated frequency is not a price -- but it must be
# SAID, not inferred from a field of zeros. pricing-test.sh fails any check
# that is neither priced nor listed here, so the silence cannot return.
# Removing a line requires adding a real freqTriple to that check, and the
# test fails a line whose check has since been priced, so this list cannot rot.
# Calibration is the principal's call. Do not invent triples to empty this file.
# Note what is NOT here: all three cra/v1.0 checks carry frequency triples and
# price non-zero, so this pack family contributes nothing to the estate's
# silent-zero finding. The two rows below are placeholder checks whose all-zero
# magnitude AND frequency are deliberate and correct -- they are never
# evaluated, so there is no exposure to price. They are declared anyway so that
# the gate covers every check in all three packs without exception, and so that
# adding a real check to either pack cannot inherit the exemption.
